title: Export to Sidiary
body:
Hello Jamorham

I'm able to write Basal-Insulin into xDrip, because i activated 'multiple Insulin'.
For my diabetes doctor i'm using SiDiary for reporting.

I observed, that the Export-File from xDrip has only one row called 'BOLUS' and my Notation of BASAL is exported there.
Is it possible to have another Row named 'BASAL' at Export?


Regards Andi

[EDIT]
See 'Basal insulin dose syncing as Bolus to tidepool.org #1158'
